current_view_hints.why_we_first_encountered_it: After the D(A4) F/R-symbol artifacts and Yasui DA4 computation work, Dic_12 was considered as another order-12 finite group whose Drinfeld double might provide a useful MTC input. Its sector count is larger than D(A4), but the computed fusion skeleton is multiplicity-free with maximum three-object F-space dimension 5, making the local gate size manageable.

scope_note: Concrete untwisted Drinfeld double MTC Rep(D(Dic_12)) = Z(Vec_Dic12), using the dicyclic group of order 12. This subject is for the category, not for one link evaluation run. The current working F/R-symbol artifacts identify the category by its Dic_12 group signature, 32 simple objects, qdim distribution 1^8 2^16 3^8, T-spectrum, S-matrix checks, and all-label F/R coherence verification.
